title: Tôi nghĩ đây là một trò lừa đảo
englishTitle: I think this is a scam
pronunciation: Toi nghi day la mot tro lua dao
summary: For naming a suspicious charge, ride, offer, or request when you need staff or police help.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Say it calmly with the receipt, chat, price, driver screen, or photo visible.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep the claim short. The evidence on your phone or paper should do most of the explaining.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi nghĩ means I think; đây là means this is; một trò lừa đảo means a scam.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi nghĩ đây là một trò lừa đảo
breakdown.english: I think this is a scam

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Police, ambulance, and passport cards help when the issue needs an official report or help from staff or authorities.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, shops, stations, police counters, or ride pickup points when something feels dishonest or unsafe.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If you feel physically unsafe, move to a staffed place and use emergency, police, or help-now phrases instead.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Unsafe, emergency, help, hospital, and passport cards cover more urgent safety paths.
